name: codebase-navigator-prompt
body:
The distributed `codebase-navigator` agent prompt file `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (product source embedded via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/agents/`). It carries the per-task implementation cadence (its "Implementation flow" section) and, for the navigator's unguarded-main-git requirement, its frontmatter `bash:` git grants: `git merge *`, `git checkout *` and `git switch *` stay out; `git worktree *` narrows to `git worktree list *`; the blanket `git branch *` narrows to the exact read-only `git branch --show-current` (a blanket `git branch *` admits ref-writing `-f`/`-D`/`-m`); `git rebase *` stays (worktree-onto-main sync, run inside the worktree) alongside read-only `git status *`/`git diff *`/`git log *`; because `git diff *`/`git log *` admit `--output=<file>` (an arbitrary-file write, including inside the main checkout), the template states that `--output=<file>` is FORBIDDEN on every granted git verb and that diff/log output goes to stdout only; the body states main is integrated only via `apg project merge`.

Deliberately a NARROW owner, distinct from the broad `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance`: `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` then maps coverage exactly to this one file. Product source in `solution.container.opencode-suite`; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts outside every change-set.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`.
